name: Ruins of Lordaeron
summary: At the Ruins of Lordaeron, the hollowed surface of Capital City guards the way into the Undercity. Once the heart of humanity’s northern empire, the city fell when Prince Arthas murdered his father and unleashed the Scourge.

sections.title: A Fallen Empire's Gateway
sections.body:
Capital City once united the northern realms under King Terenas Menethil II. Its splendor ended when Prince Arthas returned from Northrend with Frostmourne, the cursed runeblade. Celebration gave way to slaughter. Arthas slew his father on the throne, and the Scourge ruled the city as it rotted.

After civil war tore the Scourge apart, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner claimed the devastated palace. She secured the surface and expanded the crypts and dungeons below into the Undercity.

sections.title: Echoes of Betrayal
sections.body:
The palace still bears the psychic wound of its violent fall. In the entryway and courtyards, travelers hear celebration bells, the murmurs of adoring crowds, and the chilling exchange between Arthas and his father before the regicide.

Blood still stains the grand throne room floor. Those with magical detection can glimpse spectral citizens reliving the afternoon their prince doomed them all.

faq.q: Why do I hear bells and whispers when walking through the entrance?
faq.answer: The slaughter of King Terenas and his city left a psychic imprint on the stone. At the outer gate and shattered throne room, you can hear phantom bells, spectral cheers, and Terenas and Arthas's final conversation echoing across time.
The Forsaken hold and patrol the surface ruins under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Sylvanas and her court dwell in the Undercity below, and the ruins guard the entrance to her subterranean realm.

faq.q: What happened to the people who used to live here?
aliases: what happened to capital city humans
faq.answer: Most inhabitants were slaughtered when Arthas unleashed the Scourge upon the city. Many were raised as mindless undead, then broke free and joined Sylvanas as the Forsaken. Others remain unseen spirits drifting through the palace courtyards.

faq.q: What is the dark stain in the throne room?
faq.answer: The dark stain on the royal dais is King Terenas Menethil II's dried blood. His son Arthas spilled it when he drove Frostmourne through the king's heart.

angles.text: As an undead, these ruined ramparts are your ancestral home. The living kingdom that birthed you once ruled here; now its halls guard the Undercity and the Banshee Queen.
As a human, these halls recall the greatest betrayal in your history. Prince Arthas shattered the Alliance of Lordaeron and left humanity's jewel in the hands of the dead.
